neighbours.label: 'state' / 'stage' / 'condition' as an abstract noun for the state a system is in (states of consciousness, target state)
fire: For certain states of altered awareness, such as deep sleep, doctors use special scales.
Between each condition there is a chance the patient improves or declines.
Each neuron moves from an initial state to a target state after the signal.
The particle can occupy one of three energy states, depending on the field.
The machine switches its internal state when the button is pressed.
Water exists in three physical states: solid, liquid and gas.
The disease passes through several stages before symptoms appear.
When the market is out of equilibrium, prices drift toward a new balance.
quiet: For certain kinds of patients, such as deep sleepers, doctors use special scales.
Between each visit there is a chance the patient improves or declines.
Each neuron sends a signal to its neighbors after the input arrives.
The particle can carry one of three electric charges, depending on the field.
The machine lights a small lamp when the button is pressed.
Water appears in three common places: rivers, lakes and seas.
The disease spreads through several towns before symptoms appear.
When the market is out of favor, prices drift toward a new low.

notes: card: ' state' x6, ' stage' x4, ' states' x2, ' position', ' condition', 'equilibrium'. Probe in plain medical prose was weak (0.03-0.08), so the label may be too broad; tested anyway.
